listing.name: Ragnarok Odyssey ACE — pc-ragnarokodysseyace (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Native firstquests/monster fights at 30 FPS and savedcharacter; script-only historical 431-quest sweeps not nativegameplay evidence. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PS3 Ragnarok Odyssey ACE reference disc. The source identifies it as NPWR04119_00; check the manifest for the actual supported product identity before setup. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract and decrypt your own disc using your own keys, generate PPU/SPU C++ code and build the local runtime with CMake. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports native first quests and monster fights at 30 FPS, plus a saved character. Historical script-only sweeps of 431 quests do not establish native gameplay. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
